description: Bug repro (player report): pressing A to aim a weapon at a target every one of its bearers is ALREADY aimed at reported "Slugga can't fire on Witchseekers (range / line of sight)". _compute_split_fire_options had put all 10 bearers in already_allocated and none in movable (they are committed to THIS target), so eligible_remaining came back empty and the code fell into the range/LoS branch. Here the player aims the Sluggas by hand first (tutorial T4 clears boot.auto_assign_single_target so the assign steps are the player's to do), then presses A on the same target again and asserts the toast now says 'already aimed'. Then drives a GENUINE out-of-range case (Battlewagon Killkannon, 24", at the Custodian Guard) and asserts that one still gets the range/LoS warning, so the fix cannot swallow real rejections.

steps.comment: fresh container / fresh user:// = the first-launch 'First time 'ere?' nudge is up and swallows the pad menu navigation below. Dismiss it if present.
LB claims pad mode so the tutorial renders pad copy and the virtual cursor arms
glide the virtual cursor onto the main-menu Tutorial button (D-pad focus stepping depends on which control the menu happened to focus first, which is not what this scenario is testing)
RB cycles the acting unit to the Boyz

D-pad parks the virtual cursor (VirtualCursor._input calls park() on any D-pad press). The picker/Continue glides above left the cursor live, and PadRouter._assign_highlighted_target bails while the cursor owns A -- so without this the A below becomes a synthetic left-click instead of Assign Target. Only one target is eligible, so the ring does not move.
aim the Sluggas at the Witchseekers - the assignment the repro below then re-issues
precondition for the repro: all ten Sluggas are now aimed at the Witchseekers
clear any leftover toasts so the next assertion reads only the A-press result
THE REPRO: A = Assign Target on a target every Slugga is already aimed at

steps.equals: Slugga is already aimed at Witchseekers (10 of 10)
steps.comment: REGRESSION GUARD: this used to read "Slugga can't fire on Witchseekers (range / line of sight)" while the weapon row visibly read "10 -> Witchseekers". Asserted BEFORE the screenshot act, which costs ~1.5s and would push us past the toast's 3s lifetime.
the no-op A must not duplicate or drop bearers
negative control - RB on to the Gretchin...
...and on to the Battlewagon, which has two eligible targets so nothing auto-assigns
D-pad right walks the target ring to the Custodian Guard
D-pad down walks the weapon rows: big shoota -> kannon frag -> kannon shell -> killkannon (24", genuinely short of the Custodian Guard)

steps.equals: Killkannon can't fire on Custodian Guard (range / line of sight)
steps.comment: a GENUINE rejection must still say range/LoS - the fix must not swallow real ones
positive control - one more row down is the Lobba (48"), which CAN reach the Custodian Guard
a legal A-press still assigns - the empty-eligible_remaining rework did not break the normal path
